QuestInfo.name: Freezing Cold Rien Island
QuestInfo.0: Meet with Tru the Information Dealer at the Lith Harbor Info Shop for get info on how to find Aran.
QuestInfo.1: To find Aran, you must first go through Lilin. \r\nSpeak with Puro the penguin at Lith Harbor to get to Rien Island.
QuestInfo.2: You meet Lilin on Rien Island. Supposedly, she knows how to reach Aran.

0.0: What business do you have with the warrior hero? \r\n#L0##bI want to ask him about Seal Stones, so we can restore Maple Island!#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, yes, I've heard about what happened there. Very well. I will let Aran know to come find you. \r\n#L0##bReally? You will? I don't have that much money...#l\n#k
0.2: No fee, not for this. Wait for Aran at #bRien Island#k. Speak to a girl there named #bLilin#k.

yes.0: Head right after you exit my shop to find a penguin named #bPuro#k. He'll get you to Rien.
yes.1: Wait for Aran at #bRien Island#k. Speak to a girl there named #bLilin#k. Aran will meet you there.

no.0: You must've pressed the wrong button.

yes.0: Tru told me you were coming!
